identity.name: INDIABULLS LIMITED
identity.industry: Real Estate Development & Distressed Asset Resolution

summary.oneLiner: Indiabulls has completed a 3-year restructuring to emerge as a net-cash entity with a clean balance sheet, pivoting aggressively back to its core real estate competency where a INR 21,000 Cr GDV pipeline promises a 3x PAT expansion by FY28. The removal of legacy litigations and loss-making fintech ventures unlocks significant value, supported by a unique tax shield that equates PBT to PAT for the next INR 3,000 Cr of profits.

one-line thesis: Indiabulls has completed a 3-year restructuring to emerge as a net-cash entity with a clean balance sheet, pivoting aggressively back to its core real estate competency where a INR 21,000 Cr GDV pipeline promises a 3x PAT expansion by FY28. The removal of legacy litigations and loss-making fintech ventures unlocks significant value, supported by a unique tax shield that equates PBT to PAT for the next INR 3,000 Cr of profits.
financial scorecard: Revenue: INR 418 Cr (Q4), INR 881 Cr (FY26); EBITDA/Margin: Not explicitly broken out, but PAT margin ~47% in Q4; PAT: INR 195 Cr (Q4), INR 346 Cr (FY26) - Normalized due to tax shield utilization; Order Book: INR 21,000+ Cr GDV pipeline (1.1 Cr sq ft); Net Debt: Negative (Net Cash Positive ~INR 750 Cr cash, Zero Debt). One-offs: Merger of 17 entities completed; Legacy impairments fully written off; Tax shield of ~INR 3,000 Cr inherited.
guidance: Revenue Growth: Real estate profits expected to double in FY27 and triple in FY28 vs FY26 base; Margin: PBT = PAT until INR 3,000 Cr cumulative profit due to tax shield; Order Inflow: 40 Lakh sq ft launching in FY27 (GDV INR 6,000+ Cr); Capex/Commissioning: INR 600 Cr capex for Worli commercial tower, completion in 3-4 years.
order book & pipeline: Total GDV potential INR 21,000+ Cr across 1.1 Cr sq ft. Includes launched projects (75-100% sold: Estate Sector 104, Heights Sector 104), upcoming FY27 launches (40 Lakh sq ft, GDV INR 6,000+ Cr), and future pipeline (42 Lakh sq ft, GDV INR 11,900+ Cr). Mix of residential, commercial, and plotted developments in Gurugram, Mumbai, Ludhiana.
segment / subsidiary detail: Real Estate (80% of future profit): Revenue recognition on percentage completion. Key assets include Indiabulls Tower Prabhadevi (leased, est. INR 100-120 Cr/year annuity). Financial Services: Broking (INR 28 Cr PBT FY26, shifting to online/algo); ARC (AUM INR 622 Cr fee-paying, INR 3,794 Cr allocated, profits expected from FY27); NBFC (Run-off mode, INR 1,000 Cr book, zero debt, ~1% NPA).
growth verticals / optionality: 1) Commercial leasing annuity from Worli/Prabhadevi tower starting Year 4. 2) Re-rating of broking business with new online/algo stack capturing market share from incumbents. 3) Mark-to-market gains on US investment (SpringCash) as it scales disbursals. 4) Potential revival of NBFC lending post run-off (currently paused).
margins & cost dynamics: Real estate margins protected by 15% price appreciation post-launch and strict payment discipline (80% collection rate on sold units). Cost base streamlined via merger; no debt interest burden. Tax efficiency is a major margin driver (effective tax rate ~0% near term).
capex / expansion: INR 600 Cr allocated for Worli commercial tower construction over next 3-4 years. No major capex for NBFC (run-off) or ARC (fee-light model). Broking tech spend opex-focused.
capital allocation: Priority 1: Fund real estate construction (internal accruals + cash reserves). Priority 2: Scale broking tech/platform. Priority 3: Run-off NBFC book to generate cash. No dividends mentioned; focus on reinvestment for growth. Net cash position (INR 750 Cr) provides buffer.
risks & watch-items: Execution risk on delivering 3x profit growth by FY28. Real estate cycle downturn affecting sales velocity. Delay in Worli tower leasing/commissioning. Regulatory changes in broking/ARC sectors. Concentration risk in NCR/Mumbai markets.
management quality / tone: Highly confident, transparent on past failures (fintech exit), and focused on 'execution' over 'vision'. Emphasized clean balance sheet, zero litigation, and predictable earnings visibility from signed pipelines.
non-obvious takeaways: The INR 3,000 Cr tax shield inherited from the merger creates a unique scenario where PBT equals PAT for the foreseeable future, artificially inflating net margins compared to peers. The NBFC book is being run off without debt, turning a traditional leveraged business into a pure cash-flow generator.

themes.title: Real-estate up-cycle - premium housing & redevelopment
themes.need: The residential up-cycle is now presales-led with a visible margin cost. SOBHA posted its highest-ever presales at INR 3,656cr (+76% YoY, 2.34 msf at an average INR 15,655/sqft, NCR at a record INR 1,384cr) and guided FY27 presales at +30% or better - but reported EBITDA is still only ~9.7%, guided to 17-20% only by exit-Q4, and forthcoming-project marginal cash flow was cut from ~INR 86bn to INR 68.3bn on a heavier joint-development mix. SUNTECK booked INR 787cr of presales (+20%) with ZERO launches in the quarter, with aspirational-luxury (Naigaon/Kalyan) at 21% of presales 'picking up because of the lower interest rate' - the first sign the rate-elastic end is turning on demand rather than inventory release. DLF's FY26 bookings of INR20,143cr and 50mn sq ft of rental at 95% occupancy anchor the annuity leg; LODHA/GODREJPROP/PRESTIGE-tier and MMR redevelopers (RUSTOMJEE, KALPATARU, RAYMONDREL, MANINFRA, SURAJEST) ride premiumization; PHOENIXLTD/EMBDL on mixed-use.
themes.driver: SOBHA's exit-Q4 margin ramp from ~9.7% to 17-20% is the falsifiable claim (JD-heavy growth structurally lowers marginal margins); rate-elastic aspirational absorption (SUNTECK); FY27 launch-pipeline execution and festive booking momentum.
